shots.summary: Wide twilight plaza — host and friend wonder what happens if 8 billion people jump together.
shots.caption: Eight billion people. One countdown.

shots.summary: Close-up reaction — friend raises a skeptical brow.
shots.speaker: Friend
shots.caption: Wait... do we knock Earth out of orbit?

shots.summary: Scientist in tiled lab holds seismometer locked to handPos() and checks orbital momentum.
shots.caption: Earth outweighs us by a trillion to one.

shots.summary: Synchronized crowd crouch -> jump -> landing shockwave with live joule counter.
shots.caption: Landing together releases two trillion joules.

shots.summary: Blueprint energy comparison — loud local tremor, zero orbital shift.
shots.caption: Loud as thunder—yet barely a magnitude 4 tremor.

shots.summary: Deliberate calm twilight hold on the plaza as the planet keeps spinning.
